sentences.text: If the loan was sanctioned or renewed on or after 2026-01-01, a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount/limit up to ₹50 lakh for business purpose to MSEs.
The sanction letter states pre-payment charges of 2% of the amount prepaid.
The evidence does not include the loan sanction date, so the applicability of the in-force directions to this letter cannot be confirmed from the record provided.

missing.searched: Reviewed the sanction-letter and UCB pre-payment-charge evidence for a date of sanction or renewal; no sanction date was provided in the record.
